items.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: So he asked me to join his band you know? And it was nine years of one of the greatest experiences I ever had in my life.

ctx.x: Tell us about playing with Dizzy.

Now that was an experience for me I mean that will last me all my life. I’m from Philadelphia. Now I lived at 12th and Catharine. And Dizzy’s mother lived in the 1300 block of Catharine Street. So I’d been seeing Dizzy Gillespie, because he has a nephew that he took care of. You know his brother died, his oldest brother died, so he assumed the responsibility for his nephew. So the same in my family. You know my uncle and my grandmother raised me. So Dizzy’s mother and my grandmother, they used to go to the same…
